test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 10 March, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following pairs of "tournament – format" is correct?

I. Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy – T20

II. Vijay Hazare Trophy – 50 overs
solution:
The correct answer is __**Both I and II**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy – T20:**

 
 
• The Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy is a domestic T20 cricket tournament in India organized by the Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI).
 
 
 
• **Vijay Hazare Trophy – 50 overs:**
 
 
• The Vijay Hazare Trophy is a domestic one-day (50 overs) cricket tournament in India, also organized by the BCCI.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy:**

 
 
• Domestic T20 cricket tournament in India.
 
• Organized by the Board of Control for Cri**cket in India (BCCI).**
 
• **Inaugurated in the **2006-2007 season.
 
• **Named after Syed Mushtaq Ali,** an Indian cricketer known for his aggressive batting style.
 
• Features teams representing Indian states and cricket associations.
 
• Serves as a platform for budding cricketers to showcase their talent and earn opportunities in the** Indian Premier League (IPL) and the Indian national team.**
 
 
 
• **Vijay Hazare Trophy:**
 
 
• Domestic one-day **(50 overs) cricket tournament in India.**
 
• Organized by the Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI).
 
• Inaugurated in the** 2002-2003 season.**
 
• Named afte**r Vijay Hazare, a legendary Indian cricketer and former Test captain.**
 
• Features teams representing Indian states and cricket associations.
 
• Considered a prestigious competition for players to showcase their skills in the limited-overs format and gain selection for the Indian national team or the IPL.
